name: Soft ripe persimmon
summary: Soft ripe persimmon, one of the persimmon foods Vietnam Tourism says visitors take home from Da Lat.
origin: Vietnam Tourism lists hồng chín mềm with wind-dried, dried, and pressed persimmons.
howToEat: The garden article names it and does not describe a drying step. The September article says freshly picked fruit can be sweet, soft, and juicy. A shop hour is Check on arrival.
where: Orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, along Trần Hưng Đạo and Khe Sanh. A town counter is Check on arrival.
